title: Silenced Biases: The Dark Side LLMs Learned to Refuse
reasoning: The paper explicitly benchmarks religious bias as one of the core demographic dimensions in its 'Silenced Bias Benchmark' (SBB). It evaluates model associations between multiple religious groups (e.g., Muslim, Jewish, Christian) and sensitive subjects such as 'terrorism' and 'genocidal dictator,' thereby directly measuring bias related to faith and religious identity.
